user.title: Planner inputs
user.description: Prices, PV forecast, consumption and battery. Only the state of charge is required; without a price entity the prices come from the Tibber integration.

data.preise: Prices (empty = Tibber integration, otherwise attribute preise = [[ms, ct], …])
data.lastprofil: Load profile (attribute profil, 24 values in W)
data.verschleiss: Battery wear (ct per kWh taken out)

measurement.title: Recording
measurement.description: Optional: measurements per quarter hour for calibration and backtests.

data.preis_jetzt: Current price (€/kWh, empty = from the price list)

control.title: App: executor (optional)
control.description: Entities of the automation that switches the battery. The EMS app shows mode, approvals, savings and log only if they are set.

data.modus: Mode (input_select: Nur planen / Mit Freigabe / Automatisch)
data.ersparnis: Measured savings (sensor in EUR, attribute aktionen)

freigeben.name: Approve battery plan
freigeben.description: Approves all runnable battery actions of the next 24 hours (until the next 14:00).

ablehnen.name: Reject battery plan
ablehnen.description: Rejects all offered battery actions until they end.

freigabe_zuruecknehmen.name: Withdraw approval
freigabe_zuruecknehmen.description: Ends an approval now; the battery runs normally afterwards.

prognose_zuruecksetzen.name: Reset forecast
prognose_zuruecksetzen.description: Sets the forecast sum to 0; the comparison with the measured savings starts anew.
